B.label: B. SEAT - same hand changes decision because of seat

C.label: C. DRAW DEPENDENCE - apparent T2 engine but requires a topdeck
C.finding: Thrasios, Triton Hero is NOT in the opening hand - it must be drawn naturally by turn 2. The hand LOOKS like a coherent T2 engine line only because the search found it in this particular shuffle; a human evaluating the opening 7 alone would see no engine at all.

D.finding: Both hands reach Esper Sentinel as their best trajectory, but the ROBUST hand retains 4 cards with a realized second destination (Runic Armasaur), while the ALL_IN hand retains only 0 cards with no fallback - the SAME destination name is not the same trajectory quality.
